newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Flour seeks 16,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Korea Flour seeks 16,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Flour Milling Corp invited tenders to buy 16,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Thursday, traders said.
Shipment was slated for July 5-August 5 from the Pacific Northwest to South Korea's western port of Mokpo, traders said.

They said the company is seeking 5,500 tonnes of soft white wheat (minimum protein 10.5 percent), 2,600 tonnes of soft white (maximum protein 9.5 percent), 4,000 tonnes of hard red winter, and 4,400 tonnes of dark northern spring or northern spring.
